scripts.smoke:release: tsx -e "void (async () => { const base=(process.env.SMOKE_BASE_URL ?? 'http://127.0.0.1:3000').replace(/\/$/, ''); const checks=[['/health',200],['/politicians',200],['/parties',200],['/canonical-promises',200],['/vote-events',200],['/search?q=fi',200]]; for (const [pathname, expected] of checks) { const response = await fetch(base + pathname, { headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } }); if (response.status !== expected) { throw new Error(`${pathname} expected ${expected} got ${response.status}`); } } const authResponse = await fetch(base + '/auth/request-code', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ email: 'smoke@example.fi' }) }); if (authResponse.status !== 202) { throw new Error(`/auth/request-code expected 202 got ${authResponse.status}`); } console.log(`release smoke passed for ${base}`); })();"
